_doc: #3215 Q-C8 A: the suites that opt out of the shim's strict host with `makeShim({ looseHost: '<reason>' })`, each with why. This register can only SHRINK: test-loose-host.ts fails `register/shrink-only` when an entry is not in the register at the merge base (or, before this file reached main, in the seed it was measured as), and `register/stale` when an entry no longer opts out. To leave the register, stop patching the host method (patch a copy, or model the case in component-shim.ts) and delete the entry. Seeded with the 10 suites that failed the strict host on main fa3c934b.

entries.test-build-completed.ts: patches root.findAllWithCriteria to search the pages the suite builds
entries.test-native-slots.ts: patches createComponentFromNode for a host without native slots
entries.test-open-large-file.ts: patches root.findAllWithCriteria to model paged and refusing searches
entries.test-roundtrip.ts: patches combineAsVariants to hand the set back already stroked
entries.test-run-progress.ts: patches root.findAllWithCriteria to search the pages the suite builds
entries.test-run-read.ts: wraps the root in a Proxy that substitutes findAllWithCriteria to count whole-file searches
entries.test-slot-constraints.ts: patches combineAsVariants for a host that cannot take slot settings
entries.test-update-apply.ts: patches loadFontAsync so one font will not load, and createNodeFromSvg so the host does not scale an imported glyph
entries.test-update-fresh.ts: patches root.findAllWithCriteria to search the pages the suite builds
entries.test-write-components.ts: patches createNodeFromSvg to store the artboard at float32 or size it to its ink
